game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool, a pool below a waterfall: the herbalist must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool: a pool below a waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Waterfall Pool, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round, a new glowing seeds challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the sync value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 550 points of glowing seeds by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Choreography' (Week 5 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Waterfall Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sync changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Waterfall Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 550 within 43 seconds.
